CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization/emergence is present; A is absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red) is identified with explicit presented coordinates (organization) and a distinct origin/status entry for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim tied to the same content's organization/access is present; operation/command labels alone do not qualify.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content labels (red/blue) bound to coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate, inherited_current) separately attribute status/origin to identified contents across referents/times.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are represented (coordinate sets across nodes and grid orientation), indicating organization/presentation.
